name: OC Transpo static GTFS
reason: On 2026-11-16 the City of Ottawa open-data item OC Transpo Schedules (ArcGIS item af9fed684cb349ff8b6be075baf97683) pointed to this zip and linked the Open Data Licence Version 2.0, so the licence is stated. The zip itself returned HTTP 403 to the pipeline on 2026-11-16, and the developer terms page describes the separate live API licence as revocable with an indemnity. No file was retrieved, so the feed was not imported.

name: York Region Transit GTFS
reason: YRT publishes an Open Data Licence Agreement, and the download is behind a named-person request form. No anonymous file URL was available, so the feed was not retrieved.

name: Peel Region Active Recreation and Trails
reason: On 2026-11-13 the licence page returned HTML whose extracted text did not include a grant of rights. The CSV download returned a JSON status that the file was still being generated. UNKNOWN licence. Not imported.

name: City of Guelph parks, trails, sidewalks, and park locations
reason: On 2026-11-13 the licence page returned HTTP 200 and the extracted text was only the page title. No grant of rights was visible. UNKNOWN licence. Not imported.

name: City of Barrie park amenities
reason: On 2026-11-13 the published licence text was a copyright notice and a warranty disclaimer. It did not grant a right to copy, modify, or redistribute. Not imported.

name: City of London trails, sidewalks, and parking
reason: The City of London Open Data Terms of Use grant a worldwide royalty-free non-exclusive licence to use, modify, and distribute, but the City may cancel or suspend the licence and the terms include an indemnity. Redistribution must pass the terms on. Legal review is required, so these datasets were not imported.

name: City of Mississauga public washrooms and community centres
reason: The official terms href on the MiWay developer page did not return the terms on 2026-11-15, and a still-hosted PDF names the City of Toronto in the grant sentence. MiWay GTFS was removed from this pack. No additional Mississauga dataset was imported.

name: Ontario catalogue records with Licence Not Specified
reason: Packages whose catalogue licence was Licence Not Specified, including mapping-layer-data, ontario-parks-infrastructure-point-parkpnt, provincial-park-zones-parkzreg, and hospital classification lists, were not imported.

name: GO Transit and UP Express stop_amenities.txt
reason: The official GO Transit and UP Express zips downloaded on 2026-11-15 contain stop_amenities.txt with a washroom column coded as integers. No data dictionary was in the feed, so the codes were not interpreted and the file was not imported.

name: Kaggle datasets on Ontario accessibility
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. The relevant Kaggle dataset, Toronto Accessibility and Disability Data, repackages City of Toronto open data (accessible parking stalls, park and civic-building washrooms, library branches, TTC stops). Its Kaggle licence field reads Other (specified in description). Nothing was imported from Kaggle: the same files were retrieved from the City of Toronto on 2026-11-16 and imported from the publisher, which states the licence itself. Without a login the Kaggle dataset search answered one query, with two results that both repackage Canadian public data, and returned HTTP 404 for five other queries, so the pipeline could not complete a wider search.

name: City of Toronto Museums and Cultural Centres washrooms
reason: Retrieved 2026-11-16 under the Open Government Licence - Toronto (10 rows with Washroom?, Accessible? and Gender Inclusive? columns). The file has an address and no coordinates. Records are stored by 0.5-degree cell and this pipeline does not geocode, so the rows were not imported.

name: City of Toronto Traffic Beacon and Pedestrian Crossover resources
reason: Retrieved 2026-11-16 under the Open Government Licence - Toronto (358 beacons, 496 crossovers). Neither resource has an accessibility column. Not imported. The Traffic Signal resource of the same package is imported as toronto-traffic-signals.

name: City of Toronto Pedestrian Network segments without a stated sidewalk
reason: 16,356 of the 87,105 segments retrieved on 2026-11-16 are published as having no sidewalk, a partial sidewalk, a laneway without a sidewalk, a roadway under development, or no description on a road. Their line is the roadway. A path record is read as somewhere a person can travel, so these segments were left out. The other 70,749 segments are imported as toronto-pedestrian-network.

name: City of Ottawa Pedestrian Network and Sidewalks
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 and the City of Ottawa ArcGIS item links the Open Data Licence Version 2.0 (text read at https://www.ottawa.ca/opendata). The Pedestrian Network layer has 20,298 lines with a WALK_TYPE column and no surface, width, slope or curb column. The Sidewalks layer (TopographicMapping/MapServer/5) is polygons. Neither was mapped in this pass. Not imported.

name: City of Ottawa parks inventory layers 5, 7, 8, 23 and 24, drinking fountains, recreation facilities, library locations and O-Train stations
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 and the City of Ottawa ArcGIS item links the Open Data Licence Version 2.0 (text read at https://www.ottawa.ca/opendata). Layer 5 is a joined table that the service did not page (HTTP 200 with error 400 on an ordered query). Layer 7 has no filled ACCESSIBLE value. Layers 8, 23 and 24 are lines or polygons. Public Drinking Water Fountains (112 points), City Facilities for Recreation Activities (371 points), library locations and O-Train station polygons have no accessibility column. None of these were mapped in this pass. Not imported.

name: City of Ottawa records without a coordinate
reason: One parks inventory feature and one parking lot retrieved on 2026-11-16 have no usable point. Records are stored by 0.5-degree cell, so those two rows were not imported.

name: City of Brampton sidewalk segments and parks
reason: Counted at 429,007 sidewalk segments and 869 parks in the 2026-11-15 survey, with CC BY stated on the City item. Not retrieved on 2026-11-16 and not imported in this pass.

name: City of Kitchener and City of Waterloo sidewalks and parking lots
reason: The municipal open-data licence text for these two cities was not read on 2026-11-16. UNKNOWN licence. Not imported.

name: Public Services and Procurement Canada building accessibility scores
reason: The open.canada.ca package states the Open Government Licence - Canada. The file is a one-off 2020 to 2021 assessment score per federal building, and the venue schema has no field for a score. Not retrieved on 2026-11-16 and not imported in this pass.

name: Ontario Data Catalogue search for accessible places
reason: Searched on 2026-11-16 (301 packages). The open results are programme and grant tables, such as EASE grant recipients and EnAbling Change recipients, or web-only map layers. No file with a per-place accessibility column was found, so nothing further was imported from this catalogue.

name: City of Markham Parks
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 under the Open Data Licence - City of Markham (Version 1.0). 1,745 polygons with PARK_NAME, OWNERSHIP, USE_TYPE and YEAR. No amenity, washroom, parking or accessibility column. Not imported. The City of Markham catalogue (41 entries on 2026-11-16) has no dataset for accessible parking, washrooms, pedestrian signals, curb ramps, sidewalks, elevators, drinking fountains or playgrounds.

name: City of Markham Trails segments not marked public
reason: 391 of the 3,424 trail segments retrieved on 2026-11-16 have PUBLIC_ = No or blank. A path record is read as somewhere a person can travel, so they were left out. The 3,033 segments with PUBLIC_ = Yes are imported as markham-trails.

name: Town of Newmarket Parks, Municipal Parking and other Landmarks categories
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 under the Open Data Licence - Town of Newmarket (version 2.0). Parks (122 polygons) has a PARKING Y/N column and no accessibility column. Municipal Parking (108 polygons) has SPACES and SURFACE and no accessible-space column. Neither was imported. 524 of the 559 Landmarks points (schools, places of worship, cameras, ponds, parks, heritage buildings and other categories) were left out; the 35 municipal facility points are imported as newmarket-landmarks. The Newmarket catalogue (64 entries) has no dataset for accessible parking, pedestrian signals, curb ramps, sidewalks, elevators or drinking fountains.

name: York Region open data other than bus stops
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. The York Region catalogue (about 440 Region entries) is census tables, budgets, drinking water reports, traffic counts, planning maps and base mapping. Apart from Bus Stops from GTFS (imported as york-region-yrt-bus-stops) no entry has a washroom, accessible parking, facility accessibility, pedestrian signal, curb ramp or sidewalk column. Nothing else was imported. The York Region Transit GTFS zip was re-checked on 2026-11-16: https://www.yrt.ca/en/about-us/open-data.aspx still sends it only after a person agrees to the Open Data Licence Agreement and completes the YRT GTFS Data Online Form, and the Region's catalogue entry for the feed (ArcGIS item 583c66b9cd404cf38e4aa72ad3fcde6d) is only a link to that page, so the zip was not retrieved.

name: City of Vaughan open data
reason: On 2026-11-16 https://www.vaughan.ca/, https://www.vaughan.ca/opendata and https://www.vaughan.ca/business/online-maps each returned HTTP 403 to the pipeline, and https://maps.vaughan.ca/ failed TLS certificate verification. No open-data portal or licence page could be read. The City's ArcGIS Online organisation (9LnN9037wYhPG904) lists 117 public feature services, including VAUGHAN_PARKS, PARKS_TRAILS and Library; their licence field is empty or absent on the items checked, so no licence that permits redistribution is stated. Nothing was imported.

name: City of Richmond Hill open data
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. https://www.richmondhill.ca/en/find-or-learn-about/open-data.aspx returned HTTP 404 and no open-data portal or open-data licence page was found. The City's ArcGIS Online organisation (cu2HFDk7AqvG7e31) lists 58 public feature services. Where a licence field is filled it reads: This information is provided as a public resource of general information by the City of Richmond Hill. The information is provided for convenience only, and the City of Richmond Hill disclaims any responsibility for content, accuracy, currency or completeness. That is a disclaimer, not a licence to redistribute. Nothing was imported.

name: Town of Aurora Data Hub
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. The hub's Legal Disclaimer page (ArcGIS item 0d7c69d73d244fb59abaf05cb50d0dba) says all information remains the property of the Town of Aurora and that the information on the website shall not be modified, distributed, reproduced, published, licensed, transferred, or sold for a commercial purpose. The hub catalogue (22 entries) is mostly web apps, including Accessibility in Aurora; the public feature service Aurora_Accessibility (item d4f2cf00772b4ab88694dc3627edc0de) has no licence field. Redistribution is not permitted, so nothing was imported.

name: Town of Whitchurch-Stouffville
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. https://www.townofws.ca/opendata returned HTTP 404. The only ArcGIS hub found is a 2021 census hub (10 entries, no facility data). The Town's ArcGIS Online account lists 62 public feature services, including TOWS Facilities, TOWS Parks and TOWS Trails; where a licence field is filled it is a copyright notice and an as-is disclaimer of the Town, with no grant of redistribution rights. No open-data licence was found, so nothing was imported.

name: Town of Georgina
reason: Checked on 2026-11-16. https://www.georgina.ca/opendata returned HTTP 404. The Georgina Web Mapping hub catalogue has 2 entries (Web Maps and Static Maps) and no datasets. The Town's ArcGIS Online organisation (H9DyU85EnErZGhsY) lists 119 public feature services, including Park Amenities and Trail; their licence field is empty or a note that the map is created from a subset of Town data. No open-data licence was found, so nothing was imported.

name: City of Thunder Bay Recreation Facility List for Public Bookings
reason: On 2026-11-13 the licence PDF linked from the catalogue returned HTTP 404. On 2026-11-16 the PDF link still returned HTTP 404, and the same Open Data Licence 1.0 text was read at https://www.thunderbay.ca/city-hall/thunder-bay-open-data/, so the licence is now recorded in the registry for other Thunder Bay layers. This CSV has a facility name, a street address, a PHONE column and no coordinates. Records are stored by 0.5-degree cell and this pipeline does not geocode, so the rows were not imported. The PHONE column was not read.

name: Durham Region Transit GTFS
reason: Not retrieved on 2026-11-16 and not imported in that pass. Durham Region's licence text was not read. Kingston Transit and GOVA Transit, which shared this entry, were retrieved on 2026-11-16 and are imported as gtfs-kingston and gtfs-gova.

name: Thunder Bay Transit static GTFS
reason: Retrieved 2026-11-16 (HTTP 200, 731 stops with wheelchair_boarding filled). The City of Thunder Bay open-data catalogue lists the GTFS-realtime feeds on the same host and a Google Transit Source zip under its Open Data Licence, but the catalogue's own zip holds files dated 2019-11-08, and the catalogue's link to the transit developer page returned HTTP 404. No catalogue entry or City page that names this current static zip together with the licence was found, so the feed was not imported.

name: City of Thunder Bay traffic signals, transit assets, park lands and school crosswalks
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 under the City of Thunder Bay Open Data Licence 1.0. Traffic Signals and Pedestrian Crossovers (800 points) has an id column only and no audible-signal column. Transit Assets (746 points) lists shelter and garbage-can types and no accessibility column. Park Lands (195) are polygons with a name and no amenity or accessibility column. School Crosswalks (81 lines) have a paint type and colour only. Not imported.

name: City of Kingston Sidewalk Surface, Paths, Parking Surfaces and Existing Pedestrian and Cycling Facilities
reason: Reachable on 2026-11-16 under the City of Kingston Open Data Licence. Sidewalk Surface (2,710), Paths (696) and Parking Surfaces (2,847) are surface polygons with a material column, not walkable lines, and the path schema stores lines. Existing Pedestrian and Cycling Facilities (255 lines) is a planning network and was not mapped in this pass. Bus Stops (798 points) repeats the GTFS stops, which are imported as gtfs-kingston. Not imported.

name: City of Kingston Points of Interest types outside parks, recreation, civic, parking and transit
reason: 1,708 of the 2,474 points retrieved on 2026-11-16 are types such as schools, places of worship, businesses, sports fields, monuments and utilities, or type Washroom, which is the separate kingston-public-washrooms source. The layer has no accessibility column. Those rows were not imported. The other 766 points are imported as kingston-points-of-interest.

name: City of Greater Sudbury walkway segments that are not active places to walk, and recreation routes
reason: 381 of the 5,837 Road Sidewalk Path Trail segments retrieved on 2026-11-16 are proposed, abandoned or removed, or are bike paths, shoulders or untyped lines. They were left out. The other 5,456 segments are imported as greater-sudbury-walkways. The Routes layer of RECREATION_VIEW_OPENDATA (293 lines) mixes trails with on-road cycling lanes, paved shoulders and a skating path and has no surface or accessibility column; it was not mapped in this pass. Not imported.
